items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Willard Alexander and John Hammond. They were doing everything and they were the ones that brought us out of Kansas City, put us into Roseland.

ctx.x: Whose ideas was it to go in there?
I think it was Willard Alexander and John Hammond. They were doing everything and they were the ones that brought us out of Kansas City, put us into Roseland. Put us out in Pittsburgh.
Where did you play in Pittsburgh?
